title: Japan 10-year JGB auction — the October coupon slate's first, and the only 2026 JGB coupon auction on MOF's published calendar this repo does not track
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200, 24,853 bytes) and parsed cell by cell — its table row reads 'Oct. 6, 2026 | 10-year'. Both the Auction Announcement and Auction Result cells are the plain string 'Detail' with no href and the Issue column carries no number in parentheses, so nothing about this auction has been published yet; MOF prints the issue number into the row once an auction settles (2609e.htm, fetched the same day, reads '5-year (187)'). NO SIZE IS ASSERTED — none is announced, and this proposal asserts none. Filed `estimate` on the same two counts every sibling JGB entry records: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. The DATE is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Discovered 2026-09-10 during the never-assessed initial research of jgb-5y-auction-2026-10-14
notes: Discovered 2026-09-10 by reading MOF's October 2026 calendar row by row against this repo's own calendar. Every other coupon auction MOF lists for October 2026 is already tracked — 30-year 10-08, 5-year 10-14, 20-year 10-20, liquidity enhancement 5-11y 10-22 and 11-39y 10-27, 2-year 10-29 — and this row is the single gap; Treasury Discount Bills are out of scope for this calendar by standing practice. It sits D-8 from the proposing event, outside the ±5-day corridor, and is proposed on that measured completeness gap rather than on proximity. WHY IT IS WORTH A ROW BEYOND TIDINESS: the jgb-10y-auction-2026-11-05 ledger's own findings are calibrated on a 10-year series whose next print is this one, so 10-06 is the first observation that can move any of them, and it is the first Japanese coupon auction of the month that runs into the 2026-10-29/30 BoJ Outlook Report meeting. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reason every sibling JGB entry records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. This is a PROPOSAL owned by jgb-5y-auction-2026-10-14 (issue #1717) — it is inert the moment a canonical jgb-10y-auction-2026-10-06.json exists, and no other lane should edit or delete it.
